## Activity

During November 2021, Harbour Eye Clinic completed 386 captures. Activity proceeded in line with the clinic’s planned operations. Session lists ran as planned apart from routine leave, with no other operational issues identified in the information provided.

The recorded activity represents the total number of captures completed at the site during the month. This provides the basis for reviewing image quality and grading outcomes.

## Image quality

Of the images captured, 20 were ungradable. The ungradable rate was 5.2 per cent. This result indicates that most captures were suitable for assessment, while a small proportion could not be graded. The ungradable images should continue to be monitored through routine quality review.

## Grading

Grading identified 83 referable results. The median lag from photograph capture to grading was 8 days. This measure provides an overview of the time taken for images to progress through the grading process during November 2021. The findings should be considered alongside the activity volume and image-quality results when reviewing site performance.
